summary.text: Stephen Casey is a Democratic state representative from District 50 who took office in 2013 and is seeking re-election; he advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as firefighter.

paragraphs.text: Casey earned a bachelor's degree in communications from Boston College in 1990, according to Ballotpedia.
His professional experience includes working as a firefighter for the City of Woonsocket.
